title: aspidium serra
intro: Aspidium serra, commonly known as the Serrated Polypody, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium serra include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as fever and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Aspidium serra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
